paragraphs: I'm a software engineer from Rawalpindi, Pakistan. I studied Software Engineering at Iqra University in Islamabad, and most of what I know comes from building complete systems: a hospital management system, an AI-assisted medical referral app, and an AI companion for everyday life.

I care about the part of software that comes before the screens. That means understanding the domain, modelling the data and roles properly, and then deciding where AI actually helps. I build across the stack with React, Flutter, FastAPI and Convex, and I write the architecture down as I go.
I work with AI coding tools every day and treat them as a fast collaborator. The product decisions, the architecture and the review stay with me.

principles.title: Model the domain first
principles.body: Schemas, roles and workflows come before UI. Most product bugs are really modelling bugs.

principles.title: Ground the AI in real data
principles.body: AI features should work from the user’s actual data, checked for ownership, not from generic prompts.
principles.proof: MehZu AI: context assembly + memory layer

principles.title: Degrade gracefully
principles.body: When a model file or an API key is missing, the product should still work at a lower level instead of failing.
principles.proof: MedRef: keyword rules when trained models are absent

principles.title: Write it down
principles.body: Architecture notes, decision logs and roadmaps live next to the code, for teammates and for AI tools.
